apps.description:
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>与妹还债生活</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@900&display=swap');

:root {
--bg-primary: #2a1a2e;
--bg-secondary: rgba(42, 26, 46, 0.95);
--bg-overlay: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
--color-primary: #ff6b9d;
--color-primary-hover: #ff8fb3;
--color-accent: #ffc2d1;
--text-primary: #ffffff;
--text-secondary: #e8d5e8;
--text-on-primary: #ffffff;
--color-success: #4ecdc4;
--color-warning: #ffe66d;
--color-error: #ff6b6b;
--border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
--shadow-card: 0 8px 32px rgba(255, 107, 157, 0.2);
--spacing-sm: 8px;
--spacing-md: 16px;
--spacing-lg: 32px;
--radius-sm: 4px;
--radius-md: 8px;
--radius-lg: 16px;
--transition-fast: 0.2s ease;
--transition-normal: 0.3s ease;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
body { font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; background: var(--bg-primary); color: var(--text-primary); overflow: hidden; height: 100vh; position: relative; }

.scene { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 1s ease; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; }
.scene.active { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
#loadingScene { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2a1a2e 0%, #1a1a2e 100%); }

.progress-container { width: min(500px, 80vw); margin-top: 0; }
.progress-label { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: var(--spacing-sm); text-align: center; }
.progress-bar { width: 100%; height: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; }
.progress-fill { height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-primary), var(--color-accent)); width: 0%; transition: width 0.3s ease; box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--color-primary); }
.loading-detail { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 12px; margin-top: var(--spacing-sm); text-align: center; opacity: 0.8; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.6; }
.loading-mascot {
  width: min(480px, 80vw);
  aspect-ratio: 3 / 2;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  animation: mascotFloat 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.loading-mascot img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; display: block; user-select: none; -webkit-user-drag: none; }
@keyframes mascotFloat { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-6px); } }
@media (max-width: 768px) { .loading-mascot { width: min(360px, 86vw); margin-bottom: 20px; } }
.button-container { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: var(--spacing-sm); margin-top: var(--spacing-md); }

.btn { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary), var(--color-accent)); color: var(--text-on-primary); border: none; padding: 12px 32px; font-size: 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--transition-normal); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); font-weight: bold; }
.btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(255,107,157,0.4); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary-hover), var(--color-accent)); }
.btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }
.btn-secondary { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
.btn.disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; filter: grayscale(0.5); transform: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; }
#skipLoadBtn { display: none; }

#menuScene { background: url('https://miha.wiki/RZxq2f.png') center/cover no-repeat; position: relative; }
#menuScene::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: var(--bg-overlay); transition: opacity 0.8s ease; }
#menuScene.show-bg::before { opacity: 0; }
.menu-container { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--spacing-md); align-items: center; }
.menu-title { font-size: clamp(36px, 6vw, 72px); font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg); text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,107,157,0.8), 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transition: opacity 0.5s ease; }
.menu-btn {  position: relative;     /* 新增 */
  z-index: 2;             /* 新增：按钮浮在标题之上 */ width: min(300px, 80vw); padding: 16px 32px; font-size: 18px; transition: opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease; }
.menu-container.fade-out .menu-title { opacity: 0; }
.menu-title-img {
  /* 关键：布局高度锁死为原文字标题的高度，按钮位置就跟原来一模一样 */
  position: relative;     /* 新增 */
  z-index: 1;             /* 新增：标题压底 */
  height: clamp(36px, 6vw, 72px);
  width: auto;
  display: block;
  margin: 0 auto var(--spacing-lg);
  /* 视觉放大，但 transform 不影响布局，按钮岿然不动 */
  transform: scale(7.3);
  transform-origin: center center;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-drag: none;
  filter:
    drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,107,157,0.8))
    drop-shadow(0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5));
  font-size: 0;
  text-shadow: none;
  background: transparent;
  pointer-events: none;
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .menu-title-img {
    height: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
    transform: scale(9);
  }
}

.menu-container.fade-out .menu-btn { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }

#videoScene { background: #000; z-index: 10; overflow: hidden; }
#gameVideo { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transform: scale(1); transition: filter 0.8s ease, transform 0.8s ease; }
#gameVideo.blurred { filter: blur(12px); transform: scale(1.05); }
#transitionScene { background: transparent; z-index: 20; }

#eyeCloseOverlay { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 35; pointer-events: none; display: none; }
#eyeCloseOverlay .eyelid-close-top { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 0%; background: #000; }
#eyeCloseOverlay .eyelid-close-bottom { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 0%; background: #000; }

#eyeOpenScene { z-index: 30; background: #000; overflow: hidden; }
#eyeOpenScene .eye-bg { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: url('https://miha.wiki/pwYQUD.png') center/cover no-repeat; filter: blur(18px); transition: filter 0.6s ease; z-index: 0; }
#eyeOpenScene .eyelid-top { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 50%; background: #000; z-index: 10; transition: height 0.8s ease; }
#eyeOpenScene .eyelid-bottom { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 50%; background: #000; z-index: 10; transition: height 0.8s ease; }

/* ========== GAL 场景新增层 ========== */
.gal-bg { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background-size: cover; background-position: center; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.8s ease; z-index: 1; }
.gal-sprite-container { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); height: 95%; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; }
.gal-sprite { height: 100%; object-fit: contain; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
#galClickArea { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 45; display: none; cursor: pointer; }

#creditScene { z-index: 32; background: #000; overflow: hidden; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.credit-content { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.credit-title { font-family: 'Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC',sans-serif; font-size: clamp(28px,5vw,56px); font-weight: 900; color: #fff; letter-spacing: 6px; text-align: center; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); transition: opacity 0.8s ease, transform 0.8s ease; z-index: 2; position: relative; text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.15); user-select: none; }
.credit-title.show { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
.credit-title.hide { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease; }
.credit-gif-wrapper { position: absolute; bottom: -5%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: min(90vw,960px); z-index: 3; pointer-events: none; mix-blend-mode: screen; }
.credit-gif-wrapper .gif-display { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; visibility: hidden; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s ease; }
.credit-gif-wrapper.show .gif-display { visibility: visible; opacity: 1; }
.credit-gif-wrapper.show.hide .gif-display { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.6s ease; }
#creditScene.fade-out { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.8s ease; }

#bgmToggle { position: fixed; top: 20px; left: 20px; z-index: 100; width: 60px; height: 60px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.3s ease; background: transparent; border: none; padding: 0; }
#bgmToggle.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
#bgmToggle:hover { transform: scale(1.12); }
#bgmToggle:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
.disc-wrapper { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; position: relative; animation: none; box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.45), 0 0 0 2.5px rgba(255,107,157,0.25); }
#bgmToggle.playing .disc-wrapper { animation: discSpin 4s linear infinite; }
#bgmToggle:not(.playing) .disc-wrapper { animation: discSpin 4s linear infinite; animation-play-state: paused; }
@keyframes discSpin { from{transform:rotate(0deg)} to{transform:rotate(360deg)} }
.disc-cover { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
.disc-hole { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; width: 14px; height: 14px; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle,#1a1a2e 40%,#2a1a2e 70%,rgba(255,107,157,0.15) 100%); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); box-shadow: inset 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); z-index: 2; }
.disc-groove { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; border-radius: 50%; border: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); transform: translate(-50%,-50%); pointer-events: none; }
.disc-groove.g1{width:70%;height:70%} .disc-groove.g2{width:50%;height:50%} .disc-groove.g3{width:85%;height:85%}
.disc-pause-overlay { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; z-index: 3; }
#bgmToggle:not(.playing) .disc-pause-overlay { opacity: 1; }
#bgmToggle.playing .disc-pause-overlay { opacity: 0; }
.pause-icon { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.pause-icon span { display: block; width: 4px; height: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); border-radius: 2px; }

/* ========== GAL顶部功能按钮 ========== */
.top-btn { position: absolute; top: 20px; width: 110px; padding: 8px 0; background: rgba(26, 21, 32, 0.8); border: 1px solid rgba(255,107,157,0.4); color: #f0f0f0; font-size: 0.9rem; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transition: all 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; text-align: center; pointer-events: auto; touch-action: manipulation; z-index: 200; font-weight: bold; }
.top-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,107,157,0.3); transform: translateY(-2px); }
#mute-btn { left: 20px; }
#history-btn { left: 140px; }
#skip-opening-btn, #restart-btn { left: 260px; }
#view-cg-btn { right: 20px; }

/* ========== GAL 对话框 ========== */
.gal-dialog-box { position: fixed; bottom: 40px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: min(1000px,94vw); z-index: 40; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.6s ease; pointer-events: none; }
.gal-dialog-box.show { opacity: 1; }
.gal-dialog-inner { background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,5,20,0.65) 0%,rgba(20,10,35,0.75) 100%); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,107,157,0.35); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0; box-shadow: 0 8px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.7),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05); position: relative; overflow: visible; }
.gal-dialog-inner::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,107,157,0.5),transparent); }
.gal-dialog-name { position: absolute; top: -20px; left: 32px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,var(--color-primary),#e84393); color: #fff; padding: 6px 28px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; letter-spacing: 2px; box-shadow: 0 -2px 15px rgba(255,107,157,0.4); white-space: nowrap; }
.gal-dialog-text { padding: 36px 36px 28px 36px; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.8; color: #f0e6f6; letter-spacing: 1px; min-height: 160px; word-break: break-all; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
.gal-dialog-text .char { opacity: 0; display: inline; transition: opacity 0.05s ease; }
.gal-dialog-indicator { position: absolute; bottom: 12px; right: 24px; width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 8px solid transparent; border-right: 8px solid transparent; border-top: 10px solid rgba(255,107,157,0.8); animation: indicatorBounce 1s ease-in-out infinite; display: none; }
@keyframes indicatorBounce { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(5px)} }

/* ========== GAL 选项容器 ========== */
.gal-options-container { position: absolute; top: 45%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); z-index: 50; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; width: min(600px, 85vw); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.4s ease; }
.gal-options-container.show { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
.gal-option-btn { background: rgba(20, 10, 35, 0.92); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,107,157,0.5); color: #fff; padding: 18px 24px; font-size: 18px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); text-align: center; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: inherit; }
.gal-option-btn:hover { background: rgba(50, 25, 70, 0.95); border-color: var(--color-primary); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(255,107,157,0.4); }
.gal-option-btn:active { background: rgba(70, 35, 90, 0.98); transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(255,107,157,0.4); }

/* ========== 历史记录弹窗 ========== */
.history-overlay { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85); z-index: 300; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity 0.3s; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); }
.history-overlay.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }
.history-panel { width: min(800px, 92vw); height: 75vh; background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,10,28,0.97) 0%,rgba(28,16,40,0.98) 100%); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,107,157,0.3); border-radius: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 10px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); }
.history-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 16px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,107,157,0.2); font-size: 18px; color: var(--color-accent); font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 2px; }
.history-close-btn { background: none; border: none; color: #fff; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1; transition: color 0.2s; }
.history-close-btn:hover { color: var(--color-primary); }
.history-body { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 20px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: rgba(255,107,157,0.3) transparent; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; overscroll-behavior: contain; }
.history-body::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
.history-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
.history-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255,107,157,0.3); border-radius: 3px; }
.history-item { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding-bottom: 12px; }
.history-name { color: var(--color-primary); font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 6px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.history-text { color: #f0e6f6; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; }

/* ========== 结束复制弹窗 ========== */
.end-copy-overlay { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8); z-index: 400; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity 0.3s; backdrop-filter: blur(6px); }
.end-copy-overlay.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }
.end-copy-box { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(28,16,40,0.98), rgba(18,10,28,0.99)); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,107,157,0.35); border-radius: 12px; padding: 36px; text-align: center; width: min(420px, 88vw); box-shadow: 0 10px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); }
.end-copy-title { font-size: 22px; color: var(--color-accent); font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
.end-copy-desc { font-size: 15px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); margin-bottom: 28px; line-height: 1.6; }


/* 图鉴 */
.gallery-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85);
  z-index: 200;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;

  /* 关键：关闭状态和淡出期间不再接收点击 */
  pointer-events: none;

  transition: opacity 0.4s ease, visibility 0s 0.4s;
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}

.gallery-overlay.show {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;

  /* 只有真正显示时才允许点击 */
  pointer-events: auto;

  transition: opacity 0.4s ease, visibility 0s 0s;
}
.gallery-panel { position: relative; width: min(960px,92vw); height: min(85vh,800px); background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,10,28,0.97) 0%,rgba(28,16,40,0.98) 100%); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,107,157,0.3); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.7),0 0 40px rgba(255,107,157,0.1); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
.gallery-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,107,157,0.2); flex-shrink: 0; }
.gallery-header-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: var(--color-accent); letter-spacing: 2px; }
.gallery-close-btn { width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #fff; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: all 0.25s ease; line-height: 1; }
.gallery-close-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,107,157,0.3); border-color: var(--color-primary); transform: rotate(90deg); }
.gallery-body { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; padding: 20px 24px 24px 24px; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: rgba(255,107,157,0.3) transparent; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; overscroll-behavior: contain; }
.gallery-body::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px} .gallery-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent} .gallery-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,107,157,0.3);border-radius:3px}
.gallery-category{margin-bottom:28px} .gallery-category:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.gallery-category-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: var(--color-primary); letter-spacing: 2px; margin-bottom: 14px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,107,157,0.15); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.gallery-category-title::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 3px; height: 16px; background: var(--color-primary); border-radius: 2px; }
.gallery-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); gap: 12px; }
.gallery-item { position: relative; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; aspect-ratio: 3/4; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); transition: all 0.3s ease; }
.gallery-item:hover { border-color: rgba(255,107,157,0.4); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(255,107,157,0.15); }
.gallery-item img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; transition: transform 0.4s ease; }
.gallery-item:hover img { transform: scale(1.05); }
.gallery-item-placeholder { position: relative; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 3/4; background: linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,107,157,0.08) 0%,rgba(255,194,209,0.05) 100%); border: 1.5px dashed rgba(255,107,157,0.35); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 16px; }
.placeholder-text { color: var(--color-accent); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.placeholder-text .highlight { color: var(--color-primary); font-weight: bold; font-size: 22px; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.gallery-lightbox { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.92); z-index: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity 0.35s ease, visibility 0s 0.35s; cursor: pointer; }
.gallery-lightbox.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transition: opacity 0.35s ease, visibility 0s 0s; }
.gallery-lightbox img { max-width: 92vw; max-height: 90vh; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); transform: scale(0.9); transition: transform 0.35s ease; }
.gallery-lightbox.show img { transform: scale(1); }
.lightbox-hint { position: absolute; bottom: 24px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1px; pointer-events: none; }
.lightbox-close-btn { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 20px; width: 40px; height: 40px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); color: #fff; font-size: 24px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; z-index: 601; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.3s; }
.lightbox-close-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,107,157,0.5); }

/* ========== 设置弹窗 ========== */

<div class="story-block" style="position: relative; padding: 24px 28px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,107,157,0.04) 0%, rgba(255,194,209,0.02) 100%); border-left: 3px solid rgba(255,107,157,0.4); border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);">

<p style="margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 2;">一个月前,一场车祸夺走了主角的母亲和继父。</p>
<p style="margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 2;">十九岁的主角被迫从大学辍学,搬进一间狭小的公寓,和没有血缘关系的十八岁继妹——椎名紫乃——相依为命。她是主角在这个世界上唯一的家人,而主角也是她的。</p>
<p style="margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 2;">为了支撑两个人的生活,主角借了一笔贷款。利息每月累积,催收的阴影如影随形。主角必须在<span class="story-highlight" style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; padding: 2px 8px; background: rgba(255,107,157,0.15); border-radius: 4px;">180天</span>内还清全部债务——否则,等待主角与妹妹的将是无法挽回的深渊。</p>
<p style="margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 2;">白天主角在工地搬砖、在居酒屋端盘子、骑着电动车送外卖。晚上拖着疲惫的身体推开家门,玄关的灯永远亮着——紫乃站在那里,围裙上沾着油渍,轻声说:</p>
<p style="text-align: center; margin-top: 20px;"><span class="story-quote" style="display: inline-block; padding: 12px 24px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius: 8px; font-size: 16px; font-style: italic; border: 1px solid rgba(255,107,157,0.2);">"哥哥,欢迎回来。今天的饭做好了哦。"</span></p>
</div>

<div class="story-block story-danger" style="position: relative; margin-top: 20px; padding: 24px 28px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,107,107,0.06) 0%, rgba(255,107,107,0.02) 100%); border-left: 3px solid rgba(255,107,107,0.5); border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(255,107,107,0.15);">

<p style="margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 2; font-weight: bold; color: rgba(255,107,107,0.9);">但这个城市并不安全。</p>
<p style="margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 2;">有人觊觎紫乃的美貌和身体。校园里的富家公子、便利店的中年常客、伪装成好人的陌生男人……他们用金钱、权力和谎言编织陷阱,瞄准的正是那个"不想给哥哥添麻烦"的善良女孩。</p>
<div style="text-align: center; margin-top: 20px; padding: 16px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); border-radius: 8px;">
<p class="danger-text" style="color: rgba(255,107,107,0.95); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.9; margin: 0;">你能在还清债务的同时,守住她吗?<br>还是说,在你拼命工作的那些夜晚,有什么东西已经悄悄碎掉了?</p>

var preloadedImageCache = [];

function preloadImageStrict(url) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve) {
        var img = new Image();

        img.decoding = 'async';
        img.loading = 'eager';
        img.src = url;

        img.onload = function() {
            if (img.decode) {
                img.decode()
                    .then(function() {
                        preloadedImageCache.push(img);
                        resolve({ url: url, ok: true });
                    })
                    .catch(function() {
                        preloadedImageCache.push(img);
                        resolve({ url: url, ok: true });
                    });
            } else {
                preloadedImageCache.push(img);
                resolve({ url: url, ok: true });
            }
        };

        img.onerror = function() {
            console.warn('图片预加载失败:', url);
            resolve({ url: url, ok: false });
        };
    });
}

function warmupCriticalImages(){
    var critical = [
        document.querySelector('.menu-title-img'),
        document.querySelector('#bgmInfoCard .bgm-info-img-frame img'),
        document.querySelector('#bgmToggle .disc-cover')
    ].filter(function(el){ return el && el.src; });

    // 单张图最长等 600ms,decode 卡住也不会拖死整个流程
    function decodeWithTimeout(img){
        return new Promise(function(resolve){
            var done = false;
            function finish(){ if(!done){ done = true; resolve(); } }

            // 兜底超时
            setTimeout(finish, 600);

            // 已经 complete 才调 decode,否则直接放过
            if(img.complete && img.decode){
                img.decode().then(finish).catch(finish);
            } else if(img.decode){
                // 没 complete 就等 onload,onload 后再 decode
                img.addEventListener('load', function(){
                    img.decode().then(finish).catch(finish);
                }, { once: true });
                img.addEventListener('error', finish, { once: true });
            } else {
                finish();
            }
        });
    }

    return Promise.all(critical.map(decodeWithTimeout));
}

function setGalBg(src) {

    nextEl.style.backgroundImage = 'url(' + src + ')';
    nextEl.style.opacity = '1';

    activeBgLayer = nextLayer;
}

function playStoryNode(id) {
    if (id === 'end') {
        showEndCopy();
        return;
    }
    
    var node = storyData.find(function(n) { return n.id === id; });
    if (!node) return;
    
    currentNodeId = id;
    
    var nameEl = document.querySelector('.gal-dialog-name');
    if (node.name === '旁白') {
        nameEl.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        nameEl.style.display = 'block';
        nameEl.textContent = node.name;
    }
    
    var textEl = document.getElementById('galDialogText');
    textEl.innerHTML = '';
    
    if (node.bg) {
        var targetSrc = bgs[node.bg];
        if (targetSrc) {
            setGalBg(targetSrc);
        }
    }
    
    if (node.sprite) {
        if (node.sprite === 'none') {
            document.getElementById('galSprite1').style.opacity = '0';
            document.getElementById('galSprite2').style.opacity = '0';
            currentSpriteKey = 'none';
        } else {
            if (currentSpriteKey !== node.sprite) {
                var nextLayer = activeSpriteLayer === 1 ? 2 : 1;
                var nextEl = document.getElementById('galSprite' + nextLayer);
                var currEl = document.getElementById('galSprite' + activeSpriteLayer);
                
                nextEl.src = sprites[node.sprite];
                nextEl.style.opacity = '1';
                currEl.style.opacity = '0';
                
                activeSpriteLayer = nextLayer;
                currentSpriteKey = node.sprite;
            }
        }
    }

    var viewCgBtn = document.getElementById('view-cg-btn');
    var currentFocusImgSrc = '';
    
    var isCgBg = false;
    for (var key in bgs) {
        if (key.startsWith('cg') && key !== 'cg' && bgs[key] === currentBgSrc) {
            isCgBg = true;
            currentFocusImgSrc = currentBgSrc;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!isCgBg && currentSpriteKey !== 'none') {
        currentFocusImgSrc = sprites[currentSpriteKey];
    }

    if (currentFocusImgSrc) {
        viewCgBtn.style.display = 'block';
        viewCgBtn.dataset.src = currentFocusImgSrc;
    } else {
        viewCgBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }

    if (id === 's9_1') playBjSfx('normal');
    if (id === 's9_10') playBjSfx('fast');
    if (id === 's11_1') playBjSfx('cum');
    if (id === 's11_5') playBjSfx('stop');
    
    addHistory(node.name, node.text);
    
    isTyping = true;
    currentText = node.text;
    var chars = currentText.split('');
    var charSpans = [];
    chars.forEach(function(c) {
        if (c === '\n') {
            textEl.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));
        } else {
            var s = document.createElement('span');
            s.className = 'char';
            s.textContent = c;
            textEl.appendChild(s);
            charSpans.push(s);
        }
    });
    
    var i = 0;
    document.querySelector('.gal-dialog-indicator').style.display = 'none';
    
    if(typeInterval) clearInterval(typeInterval);
    
    typeInterval = setInterval(function() {
        if (i < charSpans.length) {
            charSpans[i].style.opacity = '1';
            i++;
        } else {
            finishTyping(node);
        }
    }, 35);
}

function finishTyping(node) {
    if(typeInterval) clearInterval(typeInterval);
    isTyping = false;
    var spans = document.getElementById('galDialogText').querySelectorAll('span.char');
    spans.forEach(function(s) {
        s.style.opacity = '1';
    });
    
    if (node.options && node.options.length > 0) {
        showOptions(node.options);
        document.querySelector('.gal-dialog-indicator').style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        document.querySelector('.gal-dialog-indicator').style.display = 'block';
    }
}

function handleGalClick() {
    if (isTyping) {
        var node = storyData.find(function(n) { return n.id === currentNodeId; });
        finishTyping(node);
    } else {
        var node = storyData.find(function(n) { return n.id === currentNodeId; });
        if (node && (!node.options || node.options.length === 0)) {
            playClickSfx();
            playStoryNode(node.next);
        }
    }
}

(function() {

  if (!bgmCard || !bgmBtn) return;

  // 用 hover+pointer 判定真正的PC鼠标环境，避免触屏笔记本被误判
  var isDesktop = window.matchMedia &&
                  window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;

  if (isDesktop) {
    // ========== PC端：仅鼠标悬停才显示 ==========
    var hideTimer = null;
    function showCard() {
      if (hideTimer) { clearTimeout(hideTimer); hideTimer = null; }
      bgmCard.classList.add('show');
    }
    function hideCard() {
      if (hideTimer) clearTimeout(hideTimer);
      hideTimer = setTimeout(function() {
        bgmCard.classList.remove('show');
      }, 150);
    }
    bgmBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', showCard);
    bgmBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideCard);
    bgmCard.addEventListener('mouseenter', showCard);
    bgmCard.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideCard);
    return; // PC逻辑结束，绝不执行下面的自动弹出
  }

  // ========== 移动端专属：进入主菜单1秒后弹出，停留5秒，慢速渐入渐出 ==========
  bgmCard.style.left = '80px'; // 往右挪，避开左上角唱片按钮
  bgmCard.style.transition =
    'opacity 1s ease, transform 1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)';

  var showDelayTimer = null;
  var hideDelayTimer = null;

  function clearMobileTimers() {
    if (showDelayTimer) { clearTimeout(showDelayTimer); showDelayTimer = null; }
    if (hideDelayTimer) { clearTimeout(hideDelayTimer); hideDelayTimer = null; }
  }

  function triggerMobilePopup() {
    clearMobileTimers();
    showDelayTimer = setTimeout(function() {
      bgmCard.classList.add('show');
      hideDelayTimer = setTimeout(function() {
        bgmCard.classList.remove('show');
      }, 5000);
    }, 1000);
  }

  var menuScene = document.getElementById('menuScene');
  if (!menuScene) return;

  var menuObs = new MutationObserver(function() {
    if (menuScene.classList.contains('active')) {
      triggerMobilePopup();
    } else {
      clearMobileTimers();
      bgmCard.classList.remove('show');
    }
  });
  menuObs.observe(menuScene, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });

  if (menuScene.classList.contains('active')) {
    triggerMobilePopup();
  }
})();

  var ORB_RISE_NAMES = ['orbRiseA', 'orbRiseB'];
  var ORB_SIZES = ['', 'o-sm', 'o-lg'];

  function rand(min, max) { return Math.random() * (max - min) + min; }
  function pick(arr) { return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)]; }

  function spawnPetal() {
    if (!isRunning) return;
    var petal = document.createElement('div');
    petal.className = 'sakura-petal ' + pick(PETAL_VARIANTS);
    petal.style.left = rand(-5, 100) + '%';
    var duration = rand(11, 18);
    petal.style.animation = pick(PETAL_FALL_NAMES) + ' ' + duration.toFixed(2) + 's linear forwards';
    petal.style.opacity = rand(0.55, 0.95);
    floatLayer.appendChild(petal);
    setTimeout(function() {
      if (petal.parentNode) petal.parentNode.removeChild(petal);
    }, duration * 1000 + 200);
  }

  function spawnOrb() {
    if (!isRunning) return;
    var orb = document.createElement('div');
    orb.className = 'glow-orb ' + pick(ORB_SIZES);
    orb.style.left = rand(0, 100) + '%';
    var duration = rand(8, 14);
    var riseAnim = pick(ORB_RISE_NAMES) + ' ' + duration.toFixed(2) + 's ease-in forwards';
    var twinkleAnim = 'orbTwinkle ' + rand(1.2, 2.4).toFixed(2) + 's ease-in-out infinite';
    orb.style.animation = riseAnim + ', ' + twinkleAnim;
    floatLayer.appendChild(orb);
    setTimeout(function() {
      if (orb.parentNode) orb.parentNode.removeChild(orb);
    }, duration * 1000 + 200);
  }

  var duckOnScreen = false;
  var DUCK_FALL_NAMES = ['duckFallA', 'duckFallB'];

  function spawnDuck() {
    if (!isRunning || duckOnScreen) return;
    duckOnScreen = true;

    var duck = document.createElement('div');
    duck.className = 'float-duck';
    duck.style.left = rand(8, 88) + '%';
    var duration = rand(14, 20); // 比花瓣稍慢，更容易点到
    duck.style.animation = pick(DUCK_FALL_NAMES) + ' ' + duration.toFixed(2) + 's linear forwards';

    // 点击事件：吐槽 + 不影响飘动
    duck.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      // 移除已有气泡，避免连点叠加
      var oldBubble = duck.querySelector('.duck-bubble');
      if (oldBubble) oldBubble.remove();

      var bubble = document.createElement('div');
      bubble.className = 'duck-bubble';
      bubble.textContent = '尼玛~';
      duck.appendChild(bubble);

      // 触发一下抖动反馈（包一层 inner 以免覆盖外层飘动动画）
      // 由于直接给 duck 加抖动会冲突，这里只通过气泡视觉效果体现
      setTimeout(function() {
        if (bubble.parentNode) bubble.remove();
      }, 1500);

      // 顺便播个点击音效
      if (typeof playClickSfx === 'function') playClickSfx();
    });

    floatLayer.appendChild(duck);

    setTimeout(function() {
      if (duck.parentNode) duck.parentNode.removeChild(duck);
      duckOnScreen = false;
    }, duration * 1000 + 200);
  }

  function tryDuckSpawn() {
    if (!isRunning) return;
    // 大约 8% 概率出鸭，且屏幕没鸭时才出
    if (!duckOnScreen && Math.random() < 0.08) {
      spawnDuck();
    }
  }

  function startFloating() {
    if (isRunning) return;
    isRunning = true;

    // 预先撒一批，避免初次进入时空荡
    for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      setTimeout(spawnPetal, i * 350);
    }

    // 进入菜单必定掉一只鸭，营造惊喜首遇
    setTimeout(spawnDuck, 2500);

    // 持续生成
    spawnTimers.push(setInterval(spawnPetal, 900));
    spawnTimers.push(setInterval(tryDuckSpawn, 4000)); // 每4秒掷一次骰子，约8%概率掉鸭
  }

  function stopFloating() {
    isRunning = false;
    spawnTimers.forEach(function(t) { clearInterval(t); });
    spawnTimers = [];
    // 已经在飞的让它自然消失即可，不强制清理
  }

  // 监听菜单显隐
  var observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
    if (menuScene.classList.contains('active')) {
      startFloating();
    } else {
      stopFloating();
    }
  });
  observer.observe(menuScene, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });

  // 首次如果菜单已经active，直接启动
  if (menuScene.classList.contains('active')) startFloating();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
